text_block_list.text:
Hearing singing from the rooftop, I went 
to check on it... and found T.M. Opera O 
there.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Aah~~♪ This is our era~~♪ We shall let no 
one stand in our wa~~y♪"

Apparently, she was rehearsing for a play. 
Fascinated, I stopped in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my, is that you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, I had just finished my 
practice. All that remains now is to 
welcome tomorrow's performance.
choice_data_list: ごめん、邪魔しちゃったか？
ごめん、邪魔しちゃったかな？
choice_data_list_en: Sorry, did I get in your way?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oops... a phone call. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph... I see. Then it cannot be 
helped. ...Farewell for now.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then... I must devise a solution.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing to fret over. Due to a stage 
equipment malfunction, the booked stage 
has become unavailable. That is all!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
First, let us search for a new stage! For 
there are still countless theaters in this 
world!

T.M. Opera O made inquiries to theaters and 
halls all around, but...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Umu, totally wiped out! Every single place 
was fully booked, it seems!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, if there is no stage, one simply has 
to create it oneself!
choice_data_list_en: We're in a bit of a bind...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I would love to hear your 
opinion as well. Follow me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I intend to make this my stage! What do 
you think? A truly magnificent view, is it 
not!
choice_data_list:
The wind is so strong, I doubt your voice 
will carry...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nay! Is there not a possibility that it is 
an auspicious wind sent to carry my 
beautiful voice?!
choice_data_list: 風が強くて、声が通らない気がする……
choice_data_list_en: The wind is so strong, I feel like my voice won't carry...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Aah~~♪ This is our era~~♪ We shall let no 
one stand in our wa~~y♪"
choice_data_list: I can't hear you at all...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Well played, wind!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! We shall change the setting to a 
wind-swept city! I shall incorporate a 
scene where my cape flutters magnificently 
in the gale!
choice_data_list: What about the issue with your voice?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If my voice cannot echo, then I need only 
draw closer to the audience! Let us add 
more scenes where I wander through the 
seats!
choice_data_list: 声の問題はどうするんだ？
声の問題はどうするの？
choice_data_list_en: What are we going to do about that voice issue?
What are you going to do about your voice?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall revise the script into direct 
dialogue as well! Ha, I am the sole 
performer! In short, as long as my 
rehearsals finish in time, it is of no 
consequence!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is it not obvious? Because there is an 
audience waiting for me!
choice_data_list: どうして、そこまでして……

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can see it before my very eyes...! 
The crowd surging with fervor at my 
mise-en-scène, melting before my cadenza!!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If they desire it, then joy I shall 
bestow! A world overflowing with bliss, I 
shall grant them!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Await me! Tomorrow's stage shall be 
crafted into the greatest masterpiece of 
my life!
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the front row is my highest 
recommendation! By all means, come bear 
witness to my glorious triumph!
choice_data_list: 何か手伝えることはある？
choice_data_list_en: ...I'm definitely going to go see it!
Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.text:
――The next day. T.M. Opera O finished the 
script in the nick of time and took the 
stage.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Never succumb to the murderous blade! 
Indeed, the hour to rise has come~~♪ Come, 
let us walk the road to glory 
together~~~♪"

Watching T.M. Opera O's breathtaking, 
passionate performance up close, I was 
unable to contain my excitement!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall entrust the publicity to 
you. Please spread the word far and wide 
that the venue has changed!

――The next day. The audience was sparse. 
Even though the venue change had been 
properly announced...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, gathered souls! I shall present 
to you the greatest story ever told! 
Please, enjoy yourselves to your hearts' 
content!

The size of the crowd did not matter to 
her in the slightest. Seeing her act with 
total sincerity, speaking to each and 
every person, truly touched my heart...!
